rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXVI If the Native shall attaine his Estate by just meanes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The printed chapter asks whether wealth is acquired lawfully or by indirect/impermissible dealing; it is an historical authorial allegation category, not a legal finding.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature of the Significators of Estate, who are either good or evill
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The author's primary classifier is the *condition* of estate significators, not the individual's observed morality.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent by nature
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Naturally benefic planets can qualify as benevolent estate significators in this historical method.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: posited in the Dignities of a good Planet
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: A naturally malefic planet is also counted benevolent if located in a benefic planet's dignity; this can reverse a simple planetary label.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: though naturally he is maleficall
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The explicit malefic-by-nature exception must be preserved when defining the favorable category.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: make commixion according to discretion
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly acknowledges mixed testimonies and discretionary combination; the unspecified mixing is not an executable decision function.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planets are Significators of Riches
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The favorable estate significator is a required input of this claimed legitimate-gain branch.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: doe not partake in any evill aspect with the malevolent
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The favorable significator must also avoid adverse aspects to malefics; being benefic by label is insufficient.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Riches by Warrantable and lawfull meanes, and not indirectly
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The author claims lawful acquisition under the joint conditions, but provides no independent verification of any actual person's conduct.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortunes be Significators
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Malefic planets acting as estate significators enter the author's opposite branch, subject to further conditions.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: have no correspondency with the benevolents
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: A lack of supporting correspondence with benefics is an explicit negative relationship qualifier.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: they pronounce the contrary
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly asserts the contrary of lawful acquisition under those conditions, without a verifiable allegation about a real person.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Retrograde
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Retrogradation is listed as a separate adverse modifier of the estate significator.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Combust
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Combustion is another adverse modifier, not interchangeable with retrograde motion.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Peregrine
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Peregrine status is independently listed as a condition in the alleged indirect-acquisition branch.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: otherwise much afflicted
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Other substantial affliction is an open-ended modifier, with no quantitative or reproducible threshold supplied.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planet be Significator
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: This mixed branch starts with a naturally benevolent estate significator.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: posited in the essential Dignities of Infortunes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Placement in malefic dignities alters the favorable significator's alleged ethical outcome.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Estate by direct or lawfull courses ... by indirect and unlawfull meanes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Rather than an exclusive binary, Lilly allows both lawful and unlawful methods within one natal combination.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planet be Combust or Retrograde
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Combustion or retrogradation of the benefic is separately said to give a similar mixed assessment; grammatical scope is qualified.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: malevolent Planet be Significator of an Estate
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: A naturally malefic wealth significator is another distinct case, not automatically identical to an afflicted benefic.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: placed in dignities of a Fortune
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: When the malefic occupies a benefic's dignities, Lilly allows a mixed lawful/unlawful outcome.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: malignant Planet by nature ... dignities of the Fortunes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: This case repeats the malefic-in-benefic-sign condition with further additional qualifiers in the next sentence.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: and yet ... Retrograde or Combust
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: If that malefic is also retrograde or combust, the author describes a doubling of unfavorable testimony.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: more ... Estate by unlawfull or indirect proceedings
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The source asserts a predominance of indirect gain under the intensified condition, not a proven classification of real conduct.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: On the contrary, if a good Planet be in the Dignities of the Infortunes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The counterpart starts from a benefic in malefic dignity, a different intrinsic nature and sign placement.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Retrograde or Combust
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Retrograde/combust states are required for the stronger unfavorable reverse claim.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: thrives more by unwarrantable meanes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly concludes the reverse case is more associated with unwarrantable means; no corroborating legal/financial records are offered.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: judgment depends upon four Considerations
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The original explicitly enumerates four dimensions; all must be retained rather than selecting convenient ones after outcomes.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature of the Significator, whether good or evill
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: First dimension: traditional intrinsic benefic/malefic character of the significator.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nature of the Signe he or they occupy
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Second dimension: planetary dignity or sign disposition, which may modify intrinsic nature.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: being or not being Combust
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Third dimension: a binary solar combustion condition, requiring frozen astronomy precision.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: being Retrograde or not Retrograde
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Fourth dimension: retrograde motion condition, not a proxy for solar combustion.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: determine according to the plurality of testimonies
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly resolves conflicts by majority testimony, with no mathematical weights or tie rule specified here.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: recourse to the aspects ... with other Planets
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Planetary aspects are additional corroboration/conflict inputs, increasing the risk of post-hoc selection.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter ... Lord of the second, or Dispositor of Part Fortune
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The illustrative favorable signifier Jupiter may be either second ruler or Part of Fortune dispositor: preserve this alternative.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn out of the sixth house doth cast his Square
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: An adverse Saturn square from the sixth house is deliberately added to the allegedly rich case.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter extremely fortunate and essentially dignified
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Jupiter's essential strength is part of the hypothetical; Saturn's square does not erase the favorable overall outcome.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: a most assured testimony ... very rich
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The source labels the rich natal configuration assured, but supplies no person's actual wealth data as validation.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: yet ... receive prejudice
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: An unfavorable episode is expressly allowed even when the overall estate rule is strongly positive.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Father's Kindred ... Servant or Servants ... small Cattle
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The adverse sixth-house episode is attributed to these social/economic sources within period classifications; this is not a real-person accusation.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native of sufficient age ... dealing in worldly affaires
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly requires the event subject to be old enough to transact, which is a separate eligibility condition.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Part of Fortune comes to the Termes of Saturn
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Part of Fortune's movement to Saturn's terms is a possible proposed time marker, with no orb tolerance supplied.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Square or Opposition of Saturn
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Square or opposition to Saturn is an additional proposed directional time marker, not a single independent historical hit.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: the time shall be then ... or neer that time
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The author allows an unspecified margin around the contact, making retrospective timing especially flexible.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: direct the Part of Fortune Converse and Direct
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Both converse and direct directions are mentioned as allowable processes; user-specific outcomes were not tested.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ascendant comes to the evill aspect of Saturn
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: An Ascendant-to-Saturn adverse aspect supplies yet another timing route for the same hypothesized harm.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Direction falls out to be in the second house
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The author's example further requires or notes that the direction is located in the second house.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: when in a Revolution ... Saturn in his second house
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: A solar/lunar revolution chart with Saturn in the second is a separate proposed trigger from natal directions.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: ill aspect to the Lord of the second or Part Fortune in the Radix
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: That revolution trigger is additionally qualified by an unfavorable contact with radical second ruler or Part of Fortune.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planets ... moderately fortified ... evill aspect of Infortunes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Moderately strong benefic estate indicators allegedly share some malefic influence when harshly aspected by malefics.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortunes assisted with propitious aspects of the Fortunes
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Malefics benefiting from favorable benefic aspects are said to lose much of their unfavorable influence.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators ... moderately fortified ... ever inconstant
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Moderately dignified significators are treated as inherently variable rather than an unambiguously lawful or unlawful result.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: meet with ... Terms of ... Planets ... Radix ... impede
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The author proposes more times for good or bad outcomes by contacts with natal afflicting planets' terms; precise timing method is not fixed.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: considerable judgment upon what was promised
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Lilly frames the chart as a forecast to be interpreted, but supplies no independent controlled evidence of ethics or income.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXVII If the Estate of the Native shall continue
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: Printed CXVII starts after a divider in the lower half of original PDF596 and is a different question: wealth durability.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: From the principall Significators of Substance
rules.historical_only_paraphrase: The opening of the following durability chapter is present only for boundary proof; its substantive rules are excluded from this batch.
